newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed, West Coast strong.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed, West Coast strong.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed on Tuesday as tight supply and good demand helped raise values on the West Coast, traders said.
"There is a slight shortness in supply and some good demand in Los Angeles today," said one West Coast trader, adding the market is likely to firm in the week.
Los Angeles 380 CST traded between $115 a tonne and $116 a tonne, $7 higher from prices late last week. 180 CST was assessed $121/122, $6 firmer.
"No one is willing to sell their barrels at lower levels," said one Los Angeles trader.
On the Gulf Coast, Houston bunker fuel came off highs from last week, but still remained firm amid strong NYMEX futures.
News of U.S. refiners cutting back on their runs also led to a continued strong sentiment in the market, said players.
Houston 380 CST dipped $2, trading at $110/111, and 180 CST edged down $2 to $113/114.
New York Harbor 380 CST and 180 CST remained largely steady, trading $116/119 and $122/124 respectively.
East Coast traders reported that more supply with a high metal content was on the market Tuesday, placing a premium on the low metal, better grade bunker fuel oil.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk + 1 212 859-1631
